newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas firms in Apr to Aug but volumes low.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas firms in Apr to Aug but volumes low.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market saw the period from April to August move up in thin trade on Friday, while March and September slipped back.
The market is now in backwardation from April through to August, before moving back into contango in September and resuming what one broker said was a more predictable pattern of trade.
"It's been a reasonable week," he said. "People are looking to use the IPE as an extra source of income, using it to punt around."
But only 155 lots were traded on Friday, of which 65 lots were traded in the morning session from 1000 GMT to 1200 GMT.
This was seen disappointing compared to the record-breaking sessions on Tuesday and Wednesday.
But a broker said that as the week wore on bid/offer ranges were getting tighter and there was some hope that interest was increasing even though volumes had turned down.
Institute of Petroleum (IP) Week functions "had a lot to do with the slump in volumes on Thursday," said a broker.
